:::{#exr-cov-estimator-score}
#### Covariance of an unbiased estimator with the score

Let $\vX$ have density $\p(\vx \mid \param)$ for a scalar parameter $\param$,
under the assumptions of [the exercise on the mean of the score](intro-MLEs.qmd#exr-score-mean-zero),
and let $\hparam = \hparam(\vX)$ be an [unbiased](estimation.qmd#def-unbiased) estimator of $\param$
with finite variance.
Show that the covariance of $\hparam$ with the [score](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score)
$\score(\vX \mid \param)$ equals 1.
Assume the derivative of $\E{\hparam}$ with respect to $\param$
can be taken inside the integral.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-cov-estimator-score}

The score has mean zero by [the exercise on the mean of the score](intro-MLEs.qmd#exr-score-mean-zero).
The step that rewrites the product of the score and the density uses [the exercise on the derivative of a density](intro-MLEs.qmd#exr-deriv-log-density):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Covs{\hparam}{\score}
&= \E{\hparam \score} - \E{\hparam}\,\E{\score}
&& \text{(definition of covariance)}\\
&= \E{\hparam \score} - \E{\hparam} \cdot 0
&& \text{(the score has mean zero)}\\
&= \E{\hparam \score} - 0
&& \text{($b \cdot 0 = 0$)}\\
&= \E{\hparam \score}
&& \text{($a - 0 = a$)}\\
&= \int \hparam(\vx) \, \score(\vx \mid \param) \, \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(definition of expectation)}\\
&= \int \hparam(\vx) \paren{\deriv{\param} \log \p(\vx \mid \param)} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \int \hparam(\vx) \, \deriv{\param} \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(derivative of a log density)}\\
&= \deriv{\param} \int \hparam(\vx) \, \p(\vx \mid \param) \, d\vx
&& \text{(exchange derivative and integral)}\\
&= \deriv{\param} \E{\hparam}
&& \text{(definition of expectation)}\\
&= \deriv{\param} \param
&& \text{($\hparam$ is unbiased)}\\
&= 1
&& \text{(derivative of $\param$ with respect to $\param$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
